dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Is it just me, or is my belly not as big as it used to be?

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: *sigh* Think I was just imagining things.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good day.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Hello. I am the Chief of the Children of Echoes.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Hmm... I call myself the chief, but really, I much prefer looking after and supporting everyone than managing the details of their lives.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Hello there, my friend. How have you been doing lately? Has everything been going well?

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Any friend of Kachina's is a friend of our tribe. You will always be welcome here.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Of course, you're always welcome to visit the other tribes, too. It's always fun to go for a swim at the People of the Springs, or go for a hot air balloon ride with the Flower-Feather Clan.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: See you around.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, about that stomach story...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Well... It's kind of a long story...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Basically, I was also once a dashing young man who dreamed of earning the Wayob's acknowledgment and recognition.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: And once I realized that an Ancient Name would be forever beyond my reach, food became my main way of coping with stress.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: But I've made my peace with the matter of Ancient Names. Even if I can't fight, there are still other things that I can do to support everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: You know what our mantra says: no one fights alone. My determination is just like my weight — they are both here to stay.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About fighting the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: The credit for our previous victory against the Abyss belongs to every single person of Natlan. It was a great victory, yet undeniably a temporary one.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: The Pyro Archon has visited several times after the war, inquiring about our casualties and providing strong support for our reconstruction efforts.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: However, she also emphasized that the Abyss has not yet been defeated once and for all, so we must stay vigilant.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Thank you too, for your care and contributions. I believe that as long as we all stay united, we will surely be able to persevere until victory is ours.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: No victory is eternal, but even a temporary triumph tastes sweet.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Thanks to Kion{RUBY#[D]Leader}gozi, and to you, Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini, the deeds of our heroes stand strong as the mountains and vibrant stone.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: As we warriors always say, unity will allow us to persevere until victory is won.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Thanks for your suggestion.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: Hey, come on, what's with all that politeness? We actually really like making friends with outsiders, you know.

dialogues.speaker: Pacal
dialogues.text: There's a lot we can learn from one another.
